verdicts.note: Only tax evidence is a single ESSB 6346 yes vote, with no campaign statement on taxes. A lone floor vote gets medium, the same calibration as a lone ESHB 1296 vote.

One pamphlet line ('championed healthcare for immigrants and protections against ICE') [S1], with no named bill or vote. +2 matches Siddiqi's central plank and Salomon's ICE-mask-ban record; one line supports +1 medium.

Only parental-rights evidence is ESHB 1296 sponsorship and vote; the dossier describes the bill only as amendments to the I-2081 list, so direction is inferred from I-1 seeking to undo it. Scored 1 medium to match Kloba (LD1) and the single-vote scores for Ryu, Salomon and Gregerson.

Generic 'wealthiest pay their fair share' and 'progressive revenue' language [S3] with no specific tax proposal. Ryu used the same pamphlet language and reached +2 only through her $250k expansion statement. At +2 he would rank above Davis, who voted for the tax, on rhetoric alone.
